title: Implement remaining ObjectStack Spec v0.8.2 features in console
body:
Console had ~80% spec alignment. This adds the missing short/medium-term features to reach ~95% (34/36).

## App-Level Features
- **Favicon & Title**: Dynamic updates via `branding.favicon`, document title syncs with active app
- **App Selection**: Auto-select `isDefault: true` apps, filter `active: false` from dropdown
- **Navigation Groups**: Collapsible groups via `expanded` flag, uses `Collapsible` component

## Routing
Added two new route handlers:
- `/dashboard/:dashboardName` → `DashboardView` (integrates `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`)
- `/page/:pageName` → `PageView` (integrates `PageRenderer`)

## Navigation Enhancements
- **Object Views**: Support `viewName` as query param: `/{objectName}?view={viewName}`
- **Page Params**: Navigation items with `params` field generate query strings
- **Title Formatting**: New `utils.ts` with `formatRecordTitle()` for `{fieldName}` interpolation

Example navigation with new features:
```typescript
App.create({
  isDefault: true,  // Auto-selected on load
  active: true,     // Filtered if false
  branding: {
    favicon: '/app.ico'  // Updates <link rel="icon">
  },
  navigation: [
    { type: 'object', objectName: 'contact', viewName: 'compact' },  // → /contact?view=compact
    { type: 'page', pageName: 'analytics', params: { tab: 'overview' } },  // → /page/analytics?tab=overview
    { type: 'group', expanded: false, children: [...] }  // Collapsed by default
  ]
})
```

## Files Changed
**New**: `DashboardView.tsx`, `PageView.tsx`, `utils.ts`  
**Modified**: `App.tsx` (routing + favicon), `AppSidebar.tsx` (collapsible groups), `ObjectView.tsx` (view display), `config.ts` (types), `index.html` (favicon id)

## Documentation
Updated `SPEC_ALIGNMENT.md` (EN/CN) and `IMPLEMENTATION_SUMMARY.md` to reflect completion status. Remaining 2 features (permissions, triggers) blocked on backend integration.
